verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Ghostty renders ligature fonts correctly. They also document per-font-feature enable/disable (e.g. `-calt` to turn off programming ligatures, applied to all fonts) and a repeatable font option for preferred fallback fonts when a codepoint is missing. Tuning extends to synthetic-style toggles, and the default build embeds JetBrains Mono plus built-in Nerd Fonts. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of ligature and fallback behavior, and evidence of finer metric tuning such as font size, cell-size/line-height adjustment, or variable-font axes.
